notes.title: Changing of the Pumpkins
notes.content:
The game has changed and hopefully it has changed for the better.

The original game was cute and made everyone smile and I hope that it still does it job however now it is in a state where I will be able to cater for those who want a nice simple game to grind hours away and hopefully not get bored.

The main game will not be changed anymore however the DLCs will add extra game play just by adding them. The save function will be available so when the DLCs get released then you will not have to restart the game you can continue straight into them.

Please note that the current DLCs are outdated. I will attempt to remove them however you may have to manually uncheck them in your settings. I will also be changing the visuals for the main store page.


Changes to some textures. The pumpkins look more pumpkiny.
Added the DLCs to the main game for more of a story arch and better flow.
Added new music and changed some dialog.
